description: Election Commission - Declare that L. D. G.  Perera as a member of the Dehiwala - Mt. Lavinia Municipal Council
categorisation: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a municipal council under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes, including the resignation of a council member, nomination by a political party, and declaration of a new member by the Returning Officer. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it deals with electoral matters and council member changes under election legislation.
